notes.title: Bullet Party now available for 2$!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7182957/151741e31ab171067a7a591ba8bfdbc5d37261f4.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/655910/BULLET_PARTY/

Are you ready to dance?

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] 180 levels!
[*] Co-pilot mode: dead players help their living friends!
[*] Auto adjust of speed: the game will match your ability level!
[*] Ultra bomb: when two bombs collide, they become a super sized explosion!
[*] Puzzles and speed challenges: sometimes you have to use your brain, other times, your agility!
[*] King's Crown: compete against your friends! Who is the Most Valuable Player!? [/list]

[b]Warning[/b]: This game is so flashy! It might kill photosensitive people and those with a weak heart!

notes.title: How to back Phoenix Force 2 campaign + Ending Scenes of Phoenix Force 1
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PSuafNb.png[/img]

Hello, dear players,

I want you all to know that we are going to make Phoenix Force 2!!!!! (YEAAAAH :D)

HOWEVER we don't have enough money to hire a great artist to make the graphics (NOOOOOO :C)

BUT you can help us fill that last gap and so Phoenix Force 2 can truly happen.

Before that, you should check the ending scenes of Phoenix Force 1.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T2n5baK-tGU

Beautiful, isn't?

 
[h1]How It Works[/h1]
Here is how it works: You, your friends, and other Phoenix Force players have to buy Phoenix Force 2 now, so we have a guaranteed sum of money to hire the artist, make the game and deliver it to you. It works that simple. You first have to trust that we will make good use of your money to make Phoenix Force 2 as awesome as possible. Okay? :) (Yes!)

To better organize this collective funding process, we did setup a campaign on the Brazilian (yes, Awoker Games is a Brazilian game studio) website called "Catarse". This decision has one advantage and one disadvantage.

The advantage is: Since Brazilian currency, Brazilian Reais, has lost a lot of value recently, if you back our project using any other currency,  your money will be worth a lot more for us than it is worth to you. For example, 10USD is worth 27 Brazilian Reais, and the standard contribution value is 20 Brazilian Reais. That means you'll only spend 7.50USD to buy Phoenix Force 2 and win an extra Steam Key for Phoenix Force 1 that you can gift to your friends.

And the disadvantage is: All Catarse's interface is written in Brazilian Portuguese. And you probably can't read that language. :P DO NOT FEAR! Because I shall teach you how to buy Phoenix Force 2 and pay with Visa Master Card, Diner's  Club or American Express.

 
[h1]How to buy Phoenix Force 2 and make the sequel possible[/h1]
[b]1)[/b] You should visit the "Translated" version of our campaign page, glance at our video and page description and make yourself comfortable: [url=https://translate.google.com/translate?sl=auto&tl=en&js=y&prev=_t&hl=en&ie=UTF-8&u=http%3A%2F%2Fcatarse.me%2Fpt%2Fpf2&edit-text=]HERE[/url].

[b]2)[/b] Then you visit [url=http://catarse.me/en/pf2#]this page[/url] and hit the bright green button that says: BACK THIS PROJECT

[img]http://i.imgur.com/v0jE9nB.png[/img]

[b]3) [/b]After that you'll have to sign up. You can use facebook to make things a lot more faster.

[b]4)[/b] After signing up, you should be presented with a screen like this, where you should pick the [b]R$20+ option[/b] and then hit "REVIEW AND PROCEED TO CHECK OUT". ("What if I want to contribute with more money?" I'm glad you asked that question and I made the next section about how you can buy multiple copies of the game, get access to the early beta, and even design a boss and a phoenix to the game)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xIi6gIi.png[/img]

[b]5)[/b] And this is the final step. You fill in your name, email address, and credit card info. Hit the Green button.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bWykiWS.png[/img]

[b]6) [/b]If you got to this point, congratulations, sir, you just bought Phoenix Force 2 and we are now a step closer to making this game.

 
[h1]"What if I want to contribute with more money?"[/h1]
If you made this question, you deserve a hug. :3

If you want to contribute with more than 20 Brazilian Reais, here is what you get for each tier of contribution.

[b]35 Brazilian Reais (~13USD):[/b] DOUBLE PHOENIX 2x copies of Phoenix Force 2 and 2x copies of Phoenix Force 1.

[b]60 Brazilian Reais (~22USD): [/b]PHOENIXTATIC FOUR 4x copies of Phoenix Force 2 and 4x copies of Phoenix Force 1.

[b]70 Brazilian Reais (~26USD):[/b] GREAT PHOENIX Access to early beta version.

[b]200 Brazilian Reais (~74USD):[/b] LIKE A BOSS You can design a boss that will send shivers down the spine of all players.

[b]500 Brazilian Reais (~185USD):[/b] ANCIENT PHOENIX You can design a phoenix that everybody will LOVE.

To select your reward, review step 4 of the previous section.

 
[h1]We can only make it with you![/h1]
If you love Phoenix Force, buy Phoenix Force 2 today. At this moment we are behind our expectations for this campaign and we need you to achieve success!

Love,

Sergio - Founder of Awoker Games
